rule: No vocabulary was invented for this repair. Every refused or constrained term is quoted from adopted law, and every removed term is traceable to TD_R03.

vocabularies.name: BLOCKED_STRONG_NOUNS
vocabularies.source: Field Forge R2 adopted owner and negative ceilings; OBL040 and OBL041 exact authority ceilings
vocabularies.enforcement: refused in any string enum value or exact-ref kind at authoring time
vocabularies.why_not_invented: these are the exact strong nouns adopted law already blocks; the repair quotes them rather than composing a new list

vocabularies.name: TD_R03_NON_INFERABLE_F1_PREMISE_KINDS
vocabularies.role: PREMISES a future governed rule may examine; never the rule itself
vocabularies.enforcement: refused in any authorable relation-kind enum
vocabularies.history: these three were the previous tranche's constituting relation kinds, which inverted the adopted non-inference law

vocabularies.name: AUTHORIZED_INTERACTION_RELATION_KINDS
vocabularies.source: TD_R03 §6 interaction authority and cardinality verdict
vocabularies.role: the authorable relation-kind set, which is EMPTY
vocabularies.why_empty: TD_R03 §6: no complete governed V556 interaction-rule authority was found in the audited architecture; a production F1 row requires a governed interaction rule that authorizes its exact relation kind
vocabularies.consequence: V556_INTERACTION_RELATION is lawfully VALID_EMPTY in this tranche

vocabularies.name: TD_R03_CANDIDATE_RELATION_KINDS_NOT_CANONIZED
vocabularies.role: recorded for traceability only; NOT authorable
vocabularies.why_not_canonized: TD_R03 states it does not canonize those terms merely by naming them

vocabularies.name: _FORBIDDEN_PARTICIPANT_ROLE_TOKENS
vocabularies.source: review F2/P2 plus the already-present person-state role set
vocabularies.role: token-based structural refusal of actor-semantic participant labels
vocabularies.why_tokens_not_enum: a token test refuses the whole semantic class rather than only the two labels the review happened to probe, so a new actor-semantic label cannot be coined around a fixed enum

vocabularies.name: MULTIPLICITY_POLICIES
vocabularies.source: review R7/F10; the adopted M3 seam keeps multiplicity_policy as free text
vocabularies.role: frozen named vocabulary for the substrate; the seam is unchanged
vocabularies.note: the previous tranche accepted any non-empty string, so WHATEVER_I_LIKE was authorable

vocabularies.name: PERMITTED_INCIDENCE_KINDS
vocabularies.source: retained from the previous tranche; not an F1 relation kind
vocabularies.why_safe: incidence presence/absence is a topological observation about two governed endpoints, not a claim that a pressure relation exists, so it does not collide with the TD_R03 §5 non-inference law

participant_role_semantics.note: M3 line 9 holds that objective actor identifiers are not person-state; this repair keeps that distinction and refuses the person-semantic side outright

numeric_ceiling.why: TD_R03 places quantitative combination behind a nullable numeric-formula ref unset by default, and forbids asserting numeric attractor strength or threshold without formula authority. A numeric LEAF would be exactly the smuggled scalar the review probe P9 demonstrated.
numeric_ceiling.consequence: no numeric pressure magnitude, scalar coupling value or aggregate strength can be authored through any positive path
